name: Odunayo Mohammed
headline: Fullstack Software Engineer and CTO
summary: I design and build web, mobile and payment products, and lead the teams that ship them. Currently CTO at Simple Finance and co-founder of ETeam Technology.
about: I started writing software professionally in 2013 and have spent the years since building web, mobile and payment products for startups and growing companies in Nigeria and beyond.

Today I am CTO at Simple Finance, where I lead the technology team and strategy, and co-founder of ETeam Technology, where I have overseen architecture, quality and delivery since 2017. Before that I led frontend engineering at Mazadat in Cairo.
I care about clean architecture, fast and accessible interfaces, and teams that ship every week without burning out.
